recentItems.title: "It's been emotional" Theo James & Kaya Scodelario on The Gentlemen & The Maze Runner WhatsApp Group
recentItems.description:
*Contains very strong language* The Gentlemen's Theo James, Kaya Scodelario, Vinnie Jones, Ray Winstone and Giancarlo Esposito join BBC Radio 1’s film critic Ali Plumb to talk about Season 2 of the Guy Ritchie show. They discuss getting "Ritchied" by the legendary director, their best lines, and the fact that Vinnie Jones doesn't learn his lines, or even read the script. Plus, Vinnie, Ray and Giancarlo give us their most iconic lines from Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels, Scum, Breaking Bad and many more. And Kaya discusses keeping up with her old friends The Maze Runner and Skins.
